name: Abdelsatar Ahmed Abdelsatar
headline: I build the web interfaces behind financial, administrative, and competition platforms.
intro: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience across React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript, currently building web applications at BIM Ventures.

paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer focused on the front end. I develop responsive interfaces, reusable UI components, and REST API-integrated features for products in finance, administration, and competition management.

My day-to-day stack is Next.js, React.js, TanStack, and TypeScript, styled with Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap 5. I also have a foundational background in PHP, Node.js, and MongoDB, and hands-on mobile experience with React Native.

I work with AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor to deliver faster, and I review, test, and refactor all generated code before it ships. Before moving into product work, I spent nearly two years as a Teaching Assistant at ITI and taught C++ and OOP at Orange Digital Center.
